const VDG=new Map();

function vdGeo(m){const id=m[0];let G=VDG.get(id);if(G)return G;
 const[,,ty,L,W,cab,,,wb]=m,D=Object.assign({feat:[]},VD_T[ty]||VD_T.sedan,VD_M[id]||VD_M[String(id).replace(/~F$/,'')]||{}),X=-L/2,H=W/2,N=76,zf=D.zf*L,zr=D.zr*L,xf=L/2-zf,xr=X+zr;
 const tyL=Math.min(.17*L,W*.42),arch=tyL*.78;
 const hb=x=>{let h=H-D.fl;for(const f of wb){const u=(x-(X+f*L))/arch;if(Math.abs(u)<1)h+=D.fl*Math.cos(u*Math.PI/2)**2}
  const tF=Math.max(0,(x-(L/2-zf*1.8))/(zf*1.8)),tR=Math.max(0,((X+zr*1.8)-x)/(zr*1.8));return h*(1-D.tf*tF*tF-D.tr*tR*tR)};
 const hw=x=>{let h=hb(x);if(x>xf){const u=Math.min(1,(x-xf)/zf);h*=Math.pow(Math.max(0,1-Math.pow(u,D.pf)),1/D.pf)}
  if(x<xr){const u=Math.min(1,(xr-x)/zr);h*=Math.pow(Math.max(0,1-Math.pow(u,D.pr)),1/D.pr)}return h};
 
 const P=[],K=16,NS=N-2*K;for(let k=K;k>=1;k--){const th=Math.PI/2*k/K,u=Math.pow(Math.sin(th),2/D.pr),x=xr-zr*u;P.push([x,hb(x)*Math.pow(Math.cos(th),2/D.pr)])}
 for(let i=0;i<=NS;i++){const x=xr+(xf-xr)*i/NS;P.push([x,hb(x)])}
 for(let k=1;k<=K;k++){const th=Math.PI/2*k/K,u=Math.pow(Math.sin(th),2/D.pf),x=xf+zf*u;P.push([x,hb(x)*Math.pow(Math.cos(th),2/D.pf)])}
 P[0][1]=0;P[N][1]=0;
 const Nm=P.map((p,i)=>{const a=P[Math.max(0,i-1)],b=P[Math.min(N,i+1)],dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1],l=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;return[-dy/l,dx/l]});
 const ins=new Map(),inset=d=>{let q=ins.get(d);if(!q){q=P.map((p,i)=>[p[0]-d*Nm[i][0],Math.max(0,p[1]-d*Nm[i][1])]);ins.set(d,q)}return q};
 
 const loopB=(t,d)=>{const q=d?inset(d):P;t.moveTo(q[0][0],q[0][1]);for(let i=1;i<=N;i++)t.lineTo(q[i][0],q[i][1]);for(let i=N;i>=0;i--)t.lineTo(q[i][0],-q[i][1]);t.closePath()},loop=(c,d)=>{c.beginPath();loopB(c,d)};
 
 const pc=new Map(),path2=(k,b)=>{let p=pc.get(k);if(!p){p=new Path2D();b(p);pc.set(k,p)}return p};
 
 const fromX=a=>{let i=0;while(i<N&&P[i][0]<a)i++;return i},lastY=(i0,yb)=>{let j=i0;while(j<N&&P[j+1][1]>=yb)j++;return j},firstY=(i1,yb)=>{let j=i1;while(j>0&&P[j-1][1]>=yb)j--;return j};
 
 const band=(c,s,i0,i1,d0,d1)=>{const a=inset(d0),b=inset(d1);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(a[i0][0],s*a[i0][1]);for(let i=i0+1;i<=i1;i++)c.lineTo(a[i][0],s*a[i][1]);for(let i=i1;i>=i0;i--)c.lineTo(b[i][0],s*b[i][1]);c.closePath()};
 const line=(c,s,i0,i1,d)=>{const a=inset(d);c.moveTo(a[i0][0],s*a[i0][1]);for(let i=i0+1;i<=i1;i++)c.lineTo(a[i][0],s*a[i][1])};
 
 const nose=(c,yb,d0,d1)=>{const j=lastY(fromX(L/2-zf),yb)+1,a=inset(d0),b=inset(d1);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(a[j][0],a[j][1]);for(let i=j+1;i<=N;i++)c.lineTo(a[i][0],a[i][1]);for(let i=N;i>=j;i--)c.lineTo(a[i][0],-a[i][1]);
  for(let i=j;i<=N;i++)c.lineTo(b[i][0],-b[i][1]);for(let i=N;i>=j;i--)c.lineTo(b[i][0],b[i][1]);c.closePath()};
 const tail=(c,yb,d0,d1)=>{const j=firstY(fromX(X+zr),yb)-1,a=inset(d0),b=inset(d1);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(a[j][0],a[j][1]);for(let i=j-1;i>=0;i--)c.lineTo(a[i][0],a[i][1]);for(let i=0;i<=j;i++)c.lineTo(a[i][0],-a[i][1]);
  for(let i=j;i>=0;i--)c.lineTo(b[i][0],-b[i][1]);for(let i=0;i<=j;i++)c.lineTo(b[i][0],b[i][1]);c.closePath()};
 G={D,P,N,hw,inset,loop,loopB,path2,band,line,nose,tail,fromX,lastY,firstY,tyL,arch,zf,zr};VDG.set(id,G);return G}

function vdLamp(c,G,s,front,xa,yb,d0,d1,housing,lens,glow){const i0=front?G.fromX(xa):0,i1=front?G.lastY(i0,yb):G.fromX(xa),j0=front?i0:G.firstY(i1,yb);
 if(front){G.band(c,s,i0,i1,d0-.25,d1+.3);c.fillStyle=housing;c.fill();G.band(c,s,i0,i1,d0,d1);c.fillStyle=lens;c.fill();if(glow){c.strokeStyle=glow;c.lineWidth=.45;c.beginPath();G.line(c,s,i0,i1,d0+.3);c.stroke()}}
 else{G.band(c,s,j0,i1,d0-.25,d1+.3);c.fillStyle=housing;c.fill();G.band(c,s,j0,i1,d0,d1);c.fillStyle=lens;c.fill();if(glow){c.strokeStyle=glow;c.lineWidth=.45;c.beginPath();G.line(c,s,j0,i1,d0+.3);c.stroke()}}}

function vdAt(G,front,yv,d){const P=G.P,N=G.N;let i=front?N:0;if(front){while(i>0&&P[i][1]<yv)i--}else{while(i<N&&P[i][1]<yv)i++}const q=G.inset(d)[i];return[q[0],q[1]]}

 line(c,'rgba(0,0,0,.35)',Math.max(.5,w*.1),x0-(x0-x1)*.62,-w*.35,x0-(x0-x1)*.62,w*.35);

function fan(c,lv,x,y,n,d,pyl,col){if(PASS==='d')return;const r=d/2;if(!col&&lv.eng)col=lv.eng;if(pyl)F(c,sh(col||lv.b,-.2),[[x-n*.1,y-r*.25],[x-n*.95,y-r*.12],[x-n*.95,y+r*.12],[x-n*.1,y+r*.25]]);
 if(Q<=1){c.save();c.globalAlpha=.18;el(c,'#000',x-n*.05+r*.25,y+r*.35,n*.55,r*.9);c.restore()}
 c.fillStyle=Q>=3?(col||sh(lv.b,-.1)):lg(c,0,y-r,0,y+r,[sh(col||lv.b,.15),col||lv.b,sh(col||lv.b,-.25)]);rr(c,x-n/2,y-r,n*.92,d,r*.5);c.fill();if(Q>=2){if(Q===2)el(c,'#16191c',x+n*.42,y,n*.04,r*.8);return}c.strokeStyle='rgba(20,28,36,.5)';c.lineWidth=Math.max(.6,r*.08);c.stroke();

function prop(c,lv,x,y,n,d,nb,mv,t,col){const r=d/2;if(PASS!=='d'){if(Q<=1){c.save();c.globalAlpha=.18;el(c,'#000',x-n*.1+r*.3,y+r*.4,n*.55,r*.9);c.restore()}

function rearPod(c,lv,x,y,n,d,s){if(PASS==='d')return;const r=d/2;if(Q<=2)F(c,sh(lv.b,-.15),[[x+n*.1,y-s*r*1.4],[x-n*.3,y-s*r*1.6],[x-n*.3,y-s*r*.9],[x+n*.1,y-s*r*.9]]);fan(c,lv,x,y,n,d,false)}

function lights(c0,lv,tipL,tipR,tail,spine,fw,t,st){dyn(c0,c=>{const on=st>0||t===0,b=st>0&&t>0&&(t*1.1)%1<.5,s=st>=2&&t>0&&(t*1.7)%1<.08,r=fw*.06;
 if(on){ci(c,tipL[0],tipL[1],r,'#ff3b3b');ci(c,tipR[0],tipR[1],r,'#38e07a');ci(c,tail[0],tail[1],r*.8,'#ffffff');if(Q<=1){c.save();c.globalAlpha=.3;ci(c,tipL[0],tipL[1],r*3,'#ff3b3b');ci(c,tipR[0],tipR[1],r*3,'#38e07a');c.restore()}}
 if(b||t===0){ci(c,spine[0],spine[1],r*.9,'#ff2a2a');if(b&&Q<=1){c.save();c.globalAlpha=.35;ci(c,spine[0],spine[1],r*2.6,'#ff2a2a');c.restore()}}
 if(s){ci(c,tipL[0],tipL[1],r*1.4,'#ffffff');ci(c,tipR[0],tipR[1],r*1.4,'#ffffff')}
 
 
 const nt=+(window.__TC_NIGHT||0);if(nt>0&&Q<=2){const xn=-tail[0],L=xn*2;c.save();c.globalAlpha=.32*nt;ci(c,tipL[0],tipL[1],r*6,'#ff3b3b');ci(c,tipR[0],tipR[1],r*6,'#38e07a');ci(c,tail[0],tail[1],r*4,'#ffffff');
  c.globalAlpha=.4*nt;ci(c,-L*.4,0,fw*.5,'#fff6d8');
  if(st>0&&st<4){const g=c.createLinearGradient(xn,0,xn+L*.45,0);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,248,220,.75)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,248,220,0)');c.globalAlpha=nt;c.fillStyle=g;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(xn,-fw*.2);c.lineTo(xn+L*.45,-fw*1.6);c.lineTo(xn+L*.45,fw*1.6);c.lineTo(xn,fw*.2);c.closePath();c.fill()}
  c.restore()}})}

function logo(c,lv,x,y,s){if(PASS==='d')return;if(Q>1)return;c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.fillStyle=lv.m;c.strokeStyle=lv.m;c.lineWidth=s*.16;switch(lv.k){
 case'arc':c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,s*.5,-.4,3.5);c.stroke();break;case'bird':P(c,[[s*.5,0],[-s*.4,-s*.4],[-s*.15,0],[-s*.4,s*.4]]);c.fill();break;
 case'sun':ci(c,0,0,s*.32,lv.m);break;case'stripes':for(const k of[-1,0,1])c.fillRect(-s*.45,k*s*.24-s*.06,s*.9,s*.12);break;
 case'leaf':c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,0,s*.5,s*.22,.5,0,TAU);c.fill();break;case'chev':P(c,[[s*.5,0],[0,-s*.45],[-s*.2,-s*.45],[s*.3,0],[-s*.2,s*.45],[0,s*.45]]);c.fill();break;
 case'wave':c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-s*.5,0);c.bezierCurveTo(-s*.2,-s*.4,s*.2,s*.4,s*.5,0);c.stroke();break;case'ring':c.lineWidth=s*.2;c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,s*.38,0,TAU);c.stroke();ci(c,0,0,s*.12,lv.m);break;case'diamond':P(c,[[s*.5,0],[0,-s*.32],[-s*.5,0],[0,s*.32]]);c.fill();break;default:P(c,[[s*.5,0],[s*.12,s*.12],[0,s*.5],[-s*.12,s*.12],[-s*.5,0],[-s*.12,-s*.12],[0,-s*.5],[s*.12,-s*.12]]);c.fill()}c.restore()}

function shadow(c,L,st,fn){if(PASS==='d')return;const air=st==4,ofs=[0,0,.3,.15,.9][st|0]*L*.04;c.save();c.translate(L*.02+ofs,L*.03+ofs*1.6);c.globalAlpha=air?.13:.22;fn();c.restore()}

function gear(c,x,y,w,h,n=1){if(PASS==='d')return;if(Q>1)return;for(let i=0;i<n;i++)fr(c,'#14171a',x-w/2+(i-(n-1)/2)*w*1.15,y-h/2,w,h,h/3)}

function allowCrosswalkAt(n,e,inc){
 if(P523.tRule.some(q=>q[0]===n.id&&q[1]===e.id))return false;        
  
     
 if(n.id==='D3A2'&&e.id==='D3-RE-N')return false;if(n.id==='D4B'&&e.id==='D4-RE-S'||n.id==='D5-SB'&&e.id==='PT-E1')return false;                     
 if((n.id==='E3-SW'&&e.id==='E3-WEST')||(n.id==='A6-SE'&&e.id==='A6-E-LINK'))return false;   
 if(e.cls!=='arterial'||e.corridor!=='R-MID')return true;
 if(!R_MID_CROSSING_NODE_IDS.has(n.id))return false;
 const arterial=inc.filter(q=>q.cls==='arterial'&&q.corridor==='R-MID');
 if(arterial.length<=1)return true;
 const idx=R_MID_CROSSING_NODES.indexOf(n.id),preferPositive=(idx%2)===1;
 const ranked=arterial.map(q=>{const o=_NODE_BY_ID[q.a===n.id?q.b:q.a],dx=o.x-n.x,dy=o.y-n.y;return{q,score:Math.abs(dx)>=Math.abs(dy)?(preferPositive?dx:-dx):(preferPositive?dy:-dy)}}).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score);
 return ranked[0]?.q.id===e.id;
}

function r76CrossHalf(n,e,inc){const o=_NODE_BY_ID[e.a===n.id?e.b:e.a],ex=o.x-n.x,ey=o.y-n.y,el=Math.hypot(ex,ey)||1;let h=0;

function r76VehicleAt(c){try{const node=NODES2.get(c.signalNode||c.node);if(node)for(const o of node.inside){if(o.ghost||o.standing||!o.mv)continue;if(o.mv.to&&o.mv.to.edge===c.roadId&&(o.mv.turnLeft||o.mv.turnRight))return true}}catch(x){}

  const len=Math.hypot(x2-x1,y2-y1),n=Math.max(1,Math.round(len/26));for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const px=x1+(x2-x1)*i/n,py=y1+(y2-y1)*i/n;ctx.fillStyle='#2f3a40';ctx.fillRect(px-2.2,py-2.2,4.4,4.4)}}
 for(const [px,py] of D4_GATE_POSTS)if(vis(px-4,py-4,8,8)){ctx.fillStyle='#d9b23a';ctx.fillRect(px-2.6,py-2.6,5.2,5.2);ctx.fillStyle='#2a2f33';ctx.fillRect(px-2.6,py-.6,5.2,1.2)}
 for(const [t,x,y,w] of D4_PLATES)if(vis(x-w/2,y-8,w,16))e4Plate(t,x,y,w);
 ctx.restore()}


function d4GeometryAudit(){    
 const issues=[],over=(a,b)=>a.x<b.x+b.w&&a.x+a.w>b.x&&a.y<b.y+b.h&&a.y+a.h>b.y,inside=(a,b)=>a.x>=b.x&&a.y>=b.y&&a.x+a.w<=b.x+b.w&&a.y+a.h<=b.y+b.h;
 const fp=D4_BUILDINGS.map(b=>({id:b.id,x:b.x,y:b.y,w:b.w,h:b.h}));
 const rw=EDGES.map(e=>{const a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],t=roadType(e),h=t.width/2+t.sidewalk;return{id:e.id,x:Math.min(a.x,b.x)-h,y:Math.min(a.y,b.y)-h,w:Math.abs(a.x-b.x)+2*h,h:Math.abs(a.y-b.y)+2*h}}).filter(r=>over(r,D4_BOX));
 const corr=[];    
 const corrHit=r=>{for(const c of corr)if(circleRectHit(c.x,c.y,14,r))return c.ref;return null};
 for(const f of fp){if(!inside(f,D4_BOX))issues.push(f.id+':bounds');for(const r of rw)if(over(f,r))issues.push(f.id+':road:'+r.id);const c=f.id==='D4-DC'?null:corrHit(f);if(c)issues.push(f.id+':semi-corridor:'+c)}
 for(let i=0;i<fp.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<fp.length;j++)if(over(fp[i],fp[j]))issues.push('overlap:'+fp[i].id+'/'+fp[j].id);
 for(const s of D4_SOLIDS){if(/^C4-/.test(s.id))continue;const fence=/^D4-F-/.test(s.id);for(const r of rw)if(!fence&&over(s,r))issues.push(s.id+':road:'+r.id);const c=corrHit(s);if(c)issues.push(s.id+':semi-corridor:'+c);for(const a of C4_ACCESS)if(/^D4-CUT-/.test(a.id)&&over(s,a))issues.push(s.id+':cut:'+a.id)}
 for(const s of D4_STAFF_STALLS){for(const f of fp)if(over(s,f))issues.push(s.id+':building:'+f.id);for(const r of rw)if(over(s,r))issues.push(s.id+':road:'+r.id);const c=corrHit(s);if(c)issues.push(s.id+':semi-corridor:'+c)}
 for(const o of PARKED_CARS.filter(o=>/^PC-D4-/.test(o.id)))if(!o.slotRect||!D4_STAFF_STALLS.some(s=>s.x===o.slotRect.x&&s.y===o.slotRect.y))issues.push(o.id+':not-in-stall');
 for(const p of Object.values(D4_INTERACTIONS)){for(const f of fp)if(over({x:p.x-4,y:p.y-4,w:8,h:8},f))issues.push(p.id+':poi-in-building:'+f.id)}
 for(const b of D4_TRAILER_BAYS){const r={x:b.x+8,y:b.y+4,w:b.w-12,h:b.h-8};for(const f of fp)if(over(r,f))issues.push(b.id+':building:'+f.id)}
 const program=D4_BUILDINGS.length===5&&D4_CONTAINERS.length>=4&&D4_STAFF_STALLS.length+(typeof FX3!=='undefined'?FX3.stalls.filter(s=>/^D4-ST-/.test(s[1]||'')).length:0)>=10&&    D4_EQUIPMENT.length===3&&D4_FENCE_SEGS.length>=5&&D4_PARKED_COUNT()>=5&&D4_TRAILER_BAYS.length===5;
 if(!program)issues.push('program-incomplete');
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:issues.slice(0,14),issueCount:issues.length,containers:D4_CONTAINERS.length,stalls:D4_STAFF_STALLS.length,cars:D4_PARKED_COUNT(),trees:D4ND.trees.length,lights:D4ND.lamps.length,props:D4_PROPS.length,solids:D4_SOLIDS.length,fence:D4_FENCE_SEGS.length}
}
function D4_PARKED_COUNT(){return PARKED_CARS.filter(o=>/^PC-D4-/.test(o.id)).length}


const d4NavXY=id=>({x:D4_INTERACTIONS[id].x,y:D4_INTERACTIONS[id].y});
function d4MissionReach(){const out=[],yards=[...C4_YARDS.filter(y=>/^D4-/.test(y.id)),...C4_ACCESS.filter(a=>/^D4-/.test(a.id))];
 for(const id of['D4-DC','D4-WH','D4-RAIL','D4-DOCKS']){const p=d4NavXY(id);let best=1e9;for(const e of EDGES){const a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],h=roadType(e).width/2;const x0=Math.min(a.x,b.x),x1=Math.max(a.x,b.x),y0=Math.min(a.y,b.y),y1=Math.max(a.y,b.y);const dx=Math.max(x0-p.x,0,p.x-x1),dy=Math.max(y0-p.y,0,p.y-y1);best=Math.min(best,Math.hypot(dx,dy)-h+24)}
  const onSurface=yards.some(y=>p.x>=y.x-4&&p.x<=y.x+y.w+4&&p.y>=y.y-4&&p.y<=y.y+y.h+4);out.push({id,laneDist:Math.round(Math.max(0,best)),onSurface,ok:onSurface||best<66})}
 return out}

function d4Line(P,x0,y0,x1,y1,h,v){const L=Math.hypot(x1-x0,y1-y0),n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(L/6));for(let i=P.length?1:0;i<=n;i++){const t=i/n;P.push({x:x0+(x1-x0)*t,y:y0+(y1-y0)*t,h,v})}}
function d4Arc(P,cx,cy,R,a0,a1,rev,v){const n=Math.max(4,Math.ceil(Math.abs(a1-a0)*R/6)),sg=a1>a0?1:-1;for(let i=1;i<=n;i++){const a=a0+(a1-a0)*i/n,dx=-Math.sin(a)*sg,dy=Math.cos(a)*sg;P.push({x:cx+R*Math.cos(a),y:cy+R*Math.sin(a),h:Math.atan2(rev?-dy:dy,rev?-dx:dx),v})}}
function d4Cum(P){let d=0;P[0].d=0;for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++){d+=Math.hypot(P[i].x-P[i-1].x,P[i].y-P[i-1].y);P[i].d=d}return P}



var SEMI_ART={on:true,L:165,W:25.5,Lt:49.5,a:36.135,kf:7.135,Ltr:136,wb:80,trailMax:360,step:2,pad:1,trails:new Map(),n:0,routes:[]};   
function saCum(P){let d=0;P[0].d=0;for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++){d+=Math.hypot(P[i].x-P[i-1].x,P[i].y-P[i-1].y);P[i].d=d}return P}

function saAt(P,s){const n=P.length;if(n<2)return{x:P[0].x,y:P[0].y};
 if(s<=P[0].d){const a=P[0];let j=1;while(j<n-1&&P[j].d-a.d<1)j++;const b=P[j],L=Math.max(1e-6,b.d-a.d),t=(s-a.d)/L;return{x:a.x+(b.x-a.x)*t,y:a.y+(b.y-a.y)*t}}
 const E=P[n-1];if(s>=E.d){let j=n-2;while(j>0&&E.d-P[j].d<1)j--;const a=P[j],L=Math.max(1e-6,E.d-a.d),t=(s-E.d)/L;return{x:E.x+(E.x-a.x)*t,y:E.y+(E.y-a.y)*t}}
 let lo=0,hi=n-1;while(hi-lo>1){const m=(lo+hi)>>1;if(P[m].d<s)lo=m;else hi=m}const a=P[lo],b=P[hi],t=b.d>a.d?(s-a.d)/(b.d-a.d):0;return{x:a.x+(b.x-a.x)*t,y:a.y+(b.y-a.y)*t}}

function saPoseFrom(F,H,A,o){const G=SEMI_ART;o=o||{};o.fx=F.x;o.fy=F.y;o.hx=H.x;o.hy=H.y;o.ax=A.x;o.ay=A.y;o.hc=Math.atan2(F.y-H.y,F.x-H.x);o.ht=Math.atan2(H.y-A.y,H.x-A.x);
 const k=G.Ltr-G.kf;o.rx=H.x-Math.cos(o.ht)*k;o.ry=H.y-Math.sin(o.ht)*k;o.cx=(F.x+o.rx)/2;o.cy=(F.y+o.ry)/2;o.h=Math.atan2(F.y-o.ry,F.x-o.rx);return o}
function saPoseOn(P,s,o){const G=SEMI_ART;return saPoseFrom(saAt(P,s),saAt(P,s-G.a),saAt(P,s-G.a-G.wb),o)}

function saRects(o){const G=SEMI_ART,c=Math.cos(o.hc),n=Math.sin(o.hc),k=Math.cos(o.ht),m=Math.sin(o.ht),u=G.kf-G.Ltr/2;
 return[[o.fx-c*G.Lt/2,o.fy-n*G.Lt/2,o.hc,G.Lt,G.W],[o.hx+k*u,o.hy+m*u,o.ht,G.Ltr,G.W]]}

function saTrailPose(key,fx,fy,h,o){const G=SEMI_ART;let T=G.trails.get(key);
 if(!T||Math.hypot(fx-T.P[T.P.length-1].x,fy-T.P[T.P.length-1].y)>60){const c=Math.cos(h),n=Math.sin(h);T={P:[{x:fx-c*300,y:fy-n*300,d:0},{x:fx,y:fy,d:300}]};if(G.trails.size>400)G.trails.delete(G.trails.keys().next().value);G.trails.set(key,T)}
 const P=T.P;let L=P[P.length-1];const dx=fx-L.x,dy=fy-L.y,dd=Math.hypot(dx,dy);let s=L.d;
 if(dd>.01){const Q=P[P.length-2],ux=L.x-Q.x,uy=L.y-Q.y;
  if(dx*ux+dy*uy<0){while(P.length>2){const Q2=P[P.length-2];if((fx-Q2.x)*(P[P.length-1].x-Q2.x)+(fy-Q2.y)*(P[P.length-1].y-Q2.y)>0)break;P.pop()}   
   const Q2=P[P.length-2];L=P[P.length-1];L.x=fx;L.y=fy;L.d=Q2.d+Math.hypot(fx-Q2.x,fy-Q2.y);s=L.d}
  else if(dd>=G.step){P.push({x:fx,y:fy,d:L.d+dd});s=L.d+dd}else s=L.d+dd}
 if(P.length>8&&s-P[1].d>G.trailMax){let k=1;while(k<P.length-3&&s-P[k+1].d>G.trailMax)k++;P.splice(0,k)}
 return saPoseFrom({x:fx,y:fy},saAt(P,s-G.a),saAt(P,s-G.a-G.wb),o)}

function saTrailSet(key,P,s){const G=SEMI_ART,out=[];for(const q of P){if(q.d>s)break;if(q.d>=s-G.trailMax)out.push({x:q.x,y:q.y,d:q.d})}const F=saAt(P,s);out.push({x:F.x,y:F.y,d:s});
 if(out.length<2){const B=saAt(P,s-200);out.unshift({x:B.x,y:B.y,d:s-200})}G.trails.set(key,{P:out})}

 {const c=Math.cos(o.hc),n=Math.sin(o.hc);ctx.save();ctx.translate(o.fx-c*G.L/2,o.fy-n*G.L/2);ctx.rotate(o.hc);ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(G.L/2-G.Lt-1,-G.W/2-3,G.Lt+4,G.W+6);ctx.clip();

function d4ArtGeo(){const G=D4ND.gate,S=SEMI_ART;return{XS:G.XS,yg:G.yin,R1:G.R1,r2:G.r2,XL:G.xl,RB:G.RB,Rc:G.Rc,Rs:G.Rs,ys:G.ystrip,xlc:G.xlc,Rl:G.Rl||50,back:S.a+S.wb+2,xd:D4_FACE_X+6+S.L}}

function d4ArtStopY(Y){const g=d4ArtGeo();return Math.min(Y-g.RB,g.yg-g.r2)-g.back}

function d4ArtA(x0,y0,Y){const g=d4ArtGeo(),ya=Math.max(y0,g.yg-g.R1),yi=ya+g.R1,P=[{x:x0,y:y0,h:Math.PI/2,v:26}];
 d4Line(P,x0,y0,g.XS,ya+.01,Math.PI/2,24);d4Arc(P,g.XS-g.R1,ya,g.R1,0,Math.PI/2,false,18);
 if(g.XS-g.R1>g.XL+g.r2)d4Line(P,g.XS-g.R1,yi,g.XL+g.r2,yi,Math.PI,16);d4Arc(P,g.XL+g.r2,yi-g.r2,g.r2,Math.PI/2,Math.PI,false,14);d4Line(P,g.XL,yi-g.r2,g.XL,d4ArtStopY(Y),-Math.PI/2,20);return d4Cum(P)}

function d4ArtB(Y){const g=d4ArtGeo(),P=[{x:g.xd-200,y:Y,h:0,v:12}];d4Line(P,g.xd-200,Y,g.XL-g.RB,Y,0,12);d4Arc(P,g.XL-g.RB,Y-g.RB,g.RB,Math.PI/2,0,false,11);d4Line(P,g.XL,Y-g.RB,g.XL,d4ArtStopY(Y),-Math.PI/2,14);
 return{P:d4Cum(P),sDock:200}}

function d4ArtC(Y){const g=d4ArtGeo(),dep=trafficEdgePoint(D4_DEPART_EDGE,-1,D4_DEPART_JOIN_T),fy=dep.y+SEMI_ART.L/2,P=[{x:g.xd-200,y:Y,h:0,v:16}],Rs2=Math.min(g.Rs,Y-g.Rc-g.ys);
 d4Line(P,g.xd-200,Y,g.XL-g.Rc,Y,0,16);d4Arc(P,g.XL-g.Rc,Y-g.Rc,g.Rc,Math.PI/2,0,false,13);d4Line(P,g.XL,Y-g.Rc,g.XL,g.ys+Rs2,-Math.PI/2,20);
 d4Arc(P,g.XL-Rs2,g.ys+Rs2,Rs2,0,-Math.PI/2,false,16);d4Line(P,g.XL-Rs2,g.ys,g.xlc+g.Rl,g.ys,Math.PI,22);d4Arc(P,g.xlc+g.Rl,g.ys+g.Rl,g.Rl,-Math.PI/2,-Math.PI,false,14);
 d4Line(P,g.xlc,g.ys+g.Rl,dep.x,fy,Math.PI/2,20);d4Cum(P);
 let cf=P[P.length-1].d;for(const q of P){if(q.d<200)continue;const o=saPoseOn(P,q.d);if(o.rx<g.XL-Rs2-40&&o.ry<g.ys+30){cf=q.d;break}}   
 return{P,s0:200,Cfree:cf,dep}}
function d4ArtPaths(bay){const Y=bay.dockY,B=d4ArtB(Y),C=d4ArtC(Y),dock=saPoseOn(B.P,B.sDock);return{B,C,dockY:Y,dock:{x:dock.cx,y:dock.cy,h:dock.h},dockPose:dock,A:null}}

function d4ArtAdvance(v,P,sEnd,dt,parked){if(v.ghost>0)v.ghost=Math.max(0,v.ghost-dt);const cur=v.s,dir=sEnd>=cur?1:-1;let i=1;while(i<P.length-1&&P[i].d<cur)i++;const sp=(P[i]&&P[i].v)||14,
  next=dir>0?Math.min(sEnd,cur+sp*dt):Math.max(sEnd,cur-sp*dt),o=saPoseOn(P,next,{});let hard=null;if(v.ghost<=0){hard=d4ArtSemiHit(v,o);if(!hard){v.saSkipSemis=true;try{hard=dynamicVehicleBodyBlocked(v,o.cx,o.cy,o.h,parked)}finally{v.saSkipSemis=false}}}
 if(hard){v.speed=0;v.wait=true;v.stuck=(v.stuck||0)+dt;v.yardWait=(v.yardWait||0)+dt;if(v.stuck>5){v.recoveryBoost=1.6;v.recoveries=(v.recoveries||0)+1;v.stuck=5}if(v.yardWait>12&&!/^D4-YARD-SEMI-/.test(String(hard))){v.ghost=2.5;v.yardWait=0;v.deadlockRelease=(v.deadlockRelease||0)+1;v.lastBlock=String(hard)}    return false}
 v.s=next;v.saPose=o;v.x=o.cx;v.y=o.cy;v.heading=o.h;v.speed=sp;v.wait=false;v.stuck=0;v.yardWait=0;return Math.abs(next-sEnd)<.01}

function saObbHit(a,b,pad){const dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1];if(Math.abs(dx)>(a[3]+b[3])/2+pad+30||Math.abs(dy)>(a[3]+b[3])/2+pad+30)return false;const ca=Math.cos(a[2]),sa=Math.sin(a[2]),cb=Math.cos(b[2]),sb=Math.sin(b[2]);
 for(const [ux,uy] of [[ca,sa],[-sa,ca],[cb,sb],[-sb,cb]]){const p=Math.abs(dx*ux+dy*uy),ra=a[3]/2*Math.abs(ca*ux+sa*uy)+a[4]/2*Math.abs(-sa*ux+ca*uy),rb=b[3]/2*Math.abs(cb*ux+sb*uy)+b[4]/2*Math.abs(-sb*ux+cb*uy);if(p>=ra+rb+pad)return false}return true}
function d4ArtSemiHit(v,o){const A=saRects(o);for(const w of D4_YARD_SEMIS){if(w===v||!w.saPose)continue;if(Math.abs(w.saPose.cx-o.cx)>260||Math.abs(w.saPose.cy-o.cy)>260)continue;const B=saRects(w.saPose);for(const a of A)for(const b of B)if(saObbHit(a,b,1.8))return w.id}return null}
function d4ArtSet(v,o){v.saPose=o;v.x=o.cx;v.y=o.cy;v.heading=o.h}


function saLaneAt(L,s){const n=L.ptNext;if(n&&s>n.sStart)return saMoveAt(n,s-n.sStart);if(s<=L.len)return lanePose2(L,Math.max(0,s),L.k);const p=lanePose2(L,L.len,L.k),e=s-L.len;return{x:p.x+Math.cos(p.heading)*e,y:p.y+Math.sin(p.heading)*e,heading:p.heading}}
function saMoveAt(m,q){if(q<=0)return lanePose2(m.from,m.sStart+q,m.from.k);if(q<=m.len)return polyPose2(m.pts,q);return saLaneAt(m.to,m.sEnd+q-m.len)}
function d4FrontAhead(v,d){const c=v.c2;if(!c)return null;let P0,P1;try{
 if(c.mv){P0=polyPose2(c.mv.pts,c.ms||0);P1=saMoveAt(c.mv,(c.ms||0)+d)}
 else if(c.lane){const L=c.lane,n=c.next,m=n&&n.from&&n.from.edge===L.edge&&n.from.dir===L.dir?n:null;P0=lanePose2(L,c.s||0,L.k);const r=(c.s||0)+d;P1=m&&r>m.sStart?saMoveAt(m,r-m.sStart):saLaneAt(L,r)}
 else return null}catch(e){return null}
 if(!P0||!P1)return null;return{x:v.x+P1.x-P0.x,y:v.y+P1.y-P0.y,heading:P1.heading}}

function saCorePose(v){d4ArtRoad(v);return v.saPose}
function d4ArtRoad(v){const L=SEMI_ART.L/2,h=v.heading||0,F=d4FrontAhead(v,L)||{x:v.x+Math.cos(h)*L,y:v.y+Math.sin(h)*L,heading:h};v.saPose=saTrailPose(v.id,F.x,F.y,F.heading,v.saPose||{})}
function d4ArtJoin(key,A){const T=SEMI_ART.trails.get(key),P=[];if(T)for(const q of T.P)P.push({x:q.x,y:q.y,h:0,v:A[0].v});let k0=P.length;
 if(P.length&&Math.hypot(A[0].x-P[P.length-1].x,A[0].y-P[P.length-1].y)<.05){P.pop();k0--}for(const q of A)P.push(Object.assign({},q));d4Cum(P);return{P,s:P[Math.max(0,k0)].d}}

function d4PathAt(P,s){let i=1;while(i<P.length-1&&P[i].d<s)i++;const a=P[i-1],b=P[i],t=b.d>a.d?Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(s-a.d)/(b.d-a.d))):0;let dh=b.h-a.h;while(dh>Math.PI)dh-=2*Math.PI;while(dh<-Math.PI)dh+=2*Math.PI;return{x:a.x+(b.x-a.x)*t,y:a.y+(b.y-a.y)*t,heading:a.h+dh*t}}

function d4AdvanceYardPath(v,P,dt,parked){if(v.ghost>0)v.ghost=Math.max(0,v.ghost-dt);const end=P[P.length-1].d,cur=Math.max(0,v.s||0),i=Math.min(P.length-1,Math.max(1,P.findIndex(q=>q.d>=cur))),sp=(P[i]?.v||22),nextS=Math.min(end,cur+sp*dt),q=d4PathAt(P,nextS),hard=v.ghost<=0?dynamicVehicleBodyBlocked(v,q.x,q.y,q.heading,parked):null;
 if(hard){v.speed=0;v.wait=true;v.stuck=(v.stuck||0)+dt;v.yardWait=(v.yardWait||0)+dt;if(v.stuck>5){v.recoveryBoost=1.6;v.recoveries=(v.recoveries||0)+1;v.stuck=5}if(v.yardWait>12){v.ghost=2.5;v.yardWait=0;v.deadlockRelease=(v.deadlockRelease||0)+1;v.lastBlock=String(hard)}return false}
 v.s=nextS;v.x=q.x;v.y=q.y;v.heading=q.heading;v.speed=sp;v.wait=false;v.stuck=0;v.yardWait=0;return nextS>=end-.01}
